defs.def: to make sth clearer or easier to understand 使更清晰易懂；阐明；澄清

ex.s: To clarify the definition of AI.
Clarifying the purpose of the study.
B The relationships among players have been clarified.
ex.t: B 参与者之间的关系已经明确。

ex.s: Asking for clarification Clarifying Stating advantages Finance management tips for freshmen Welcome to Winfield University.
ex.t: 要求澄清说明优势为新生提供财务管理技巧欢迎来到温菲尔德大学。

ex.s: Use the table below to clarify any misunderstandings or different answers.
ex.t: 使用下表来澄清任何误解或不同的答案。

ex.s: Clarifying and Asking Questions Clarifying Let me Did + Asking Questions So everyone watched the same TV programme?
ex.t: 澄清和提问澄清让我做+问问题所以每个人都看了同一个电视节目？

ex.s: Clarifying and Asking Questions Complete the dialogue with the expressions below.
ex.t: 澄清和提出问题用下面的表达完成对话。

ex.s: Clarify the recent changes on Internet use.
ex.t: 澄清互联网使用方面的最新变化。

defs.def: to make sth, especially butter, pure by heating it （尤指通过加热使黄油）纯净，净化
